subject: english
question:
**Identify the segment that contains a grammatical error. If there is no error, select 'No error'. **

It is one of the best books whom I have ever read.
solution:
The correct answer is **'best books whom'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The given sentence is grammatically incorrect.
 
• Here, **'best books that'** should be used instead of **'best books whom'.**
 
• We know that 'that' is 'used for the person or thing already mentioned'. [(संबंधवाचक उपवाक्‍यों के शुरू में प्रयुक्त) पूर्व निर्दिष्ट व्‍यक्ति या वस्‍तु]
